description: Fields' names as every app writes them: NASR APT_BASE's ARPT_NAME title-cased as Python's str.title() does, the FAA's codes kept in capitals (AAF, AFB, AHP, ANGB, ARB, JRB, MCAS, MCAF, NAS, NAF, NAWS, NOLF, OLF, USAF, USCG, CGAS, LLC): "SIERRA VISTA MUNI-LIBBY AAF" is "Sierra Vista Muni-Libby AAF". The phones' packs name fields so too.
